t: An open source module for building a knitted companion robot that mirrors head movements.
steps: Find the Build Your Own Robot Friend module and its project repository.
Read the assembly guides and watch the video tutorials.
Get a 3D printer or arrange printed parts.
Collect yarn and the crochet patterns.
Build one robot as a teacher before class.
Ask IT to help set up the pose tracking software.
Plan a short discussion on AI ethics.
